mapper.sql: id, customer_id, name, phone, email, position, is_primary, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE opc_crm_contact SET customer_id = #{customerId}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, position = #{position}, is_primary = #{isPrimary}, remark = #{remark}, deleted = #{deleted}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT ct.id, ct.customer_id, ct.name, ct.phone, ct.email, ct.position, ct.is_primary, ct.remark, ct.create_by, ct.create_time, ct.update_by, ct.update_time, ct.deleted FROM opc_crm_contact ct JOIN opc_crm_customer cu ON cu.id = ct.customer_id WHERE ct.id = #{id} AND cu.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND ct.deleted = 0 AND cu.deleted = 0

SELECT ct.id, ct.customer_id, ct.name, ct.phone, ct.email, ct.position, ct.is_primary, ct.remark, ct.create_by, ct.create_time, ct.update_by, ct.update_time, ct.deleted FROM opc_crm_contact ct JOIN opc_crm_customer cu ON cu.id = ct.customer_id WHERE ct.customer_id = #{customerId} AND cu.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND ct.deleted = 0 AND cu.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ct.is_primary DESC, ct.create_time DESC
